hook: Could you cover a $400 emergency in cash tomorrow? In recent Federal Reserve surveys, more than a third of American adults said they couldn't. In this video I look at emergency funds from three angles: the numbers (how much you need and what it costs not to have one), the psychology of why saving for emergencies feels impossible, and 12 steps to build one from absolutely zero.
